notes.title: Level editor and arcade mode
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38988204/0e3ec2caa420d3361b5b81b2d3f4d19ddd181736.png

This update contain some candy for the creative mind. 

The highlights are:
- Support to create arcade levels in the built-in level editor. 
- Support to share your levels with other players and play levels they have created.

Extra:
- Added a restart level button to speed up exploration and avoid tedious/repetitive undo clicking.
- Added support for using the backspace key to undo a move.
- Fixed a zoom in/out bug that made the camera flip 180 degrees.
- Fixed issue where a block could fall even though Max did not touch the block. 

Here is a video showing how you can create a level and share it with the world: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X9qdYJBC3Ds

Please note that there are more features than shown in the video but this video aims to cover the basics. 

A shout-out to Dohi64 for a lot of great input about things to improve. This update does not cover everything mentioned but it should be a step in the right direction.
